item.title: Version 1.2.25 (Build 20261003)
item.description:
What's New

fix(hotkey): ignore modifier-only hotkey on hold, extra modifier, or mouse/media input

A modifier-only toggle (e.g. Fn) fired on release even when the key was held

as a modifier for other actions. Fire only on a tap under 0.5s with no extra

modifier added, and cancel the pending toggle on mouse or media-key events,

which are outside the event tap mask. A spoiled gesture cannot re-arm until

all modifiers are released.

Fixes #328
